title: Public Law 119-52: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule…
summary: H.J.Res. 131, "Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Bureau of Land Management relating to Coastal Plain Oil and Gas Leasing Program Record of Decision.", originated in the House of the 119th Congress and became Public Law 119-52 on 2025-12-11, according to Congress.gov.
